content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having an issue with my [product_name] Communication Module; it does not send SMS messages to all users in a recipient group. Out of 10 users, only 2 receive the messages, and sometimes none do. System logs show: 'The SMS message could not be sent' at several timestamps. The device has a good network signal. Thank you. Open to comments.
This is an English-speaking forum. Please post your messages in English.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing unreliable SMS delivery from their [product_name] Communication Module. Out of a group of 10 recipients, messages only reach 2 or sometimes none, confirmed by error logs even though the network signal is strong. This highlights a problem with bulk SMS functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all SMS messages to be reliably sent to every intended recipient in the group whenever the network signal is sufficient.
